description: Figure 1 displays the similarity of Hidden States Across (HSAs) for four language pairs across all layers of the Qwen1.5-1.8B model. The x-axis represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to 22, with tick marks at regular intervals of 2. The y-axis represents similarity, scaled linearly from 0.00 to 0.45. Four distinct lines represent the language pairs: 'en&en' (red line with circle markers, solid line), 'en&es' (blue line with triangle markers, dashed line), 'en&el' (green line with square markers, dash-dot line), and 'en&bn' (purple line with diamond markers, dotted line). The 'en&en' line consistently shows the highest similarity, peaking around layer 6 at approximately 0.25 and again sharply rising after layer 20 to reach nearly 0.45 at layer 22. The other three language pairs exhibit lower similarity values, with 'en&es' and 'en&bn' showing similar trends, peaking around layer 6 at approximately 0.20 and then declining to around 0.05 by layer 22, while 'en&el' remains the lowest, staying below 0.10 throughout the layers.
